description: This file defines data structures, macros, and external function declarations for parsing and evaluating plural forms in internationalization, used in GNU gettext and related libraries.

methods.name: FREE_EXPRESSION
methods.description: Function to free expression structures, name varies based on context.

methods.description: Function to parse plural expression strings.

methods.name: EXTRACT_PLURAL_EXPRESSION
methods.description: Function to extract plural expression from a string.
